title: Dirichlet domains and the NEC uniformization of extremal hyperbolic surfaces
summary: Extremal hyperbolic surfaces are finite-type hyperbolic surfaces that contain an embedded disc of the largest possible radius. We introduce a new general approach to these objects, based on the uniformization by NEC groups, obtaining a structural description of the Dirichlet domains associated to extremal disc centers for surfaces with cusps and/or geodesic boundary.
